title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent finds code injection in YDB workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: YDB’s validate-pr-description GitHub Actions workflow interpolates pull request-controlled text into a shell command in a privileged pull_request_target job, creating code injection risk.
ai_role: The GHSL advisory credits both CodeQL and an AI agent developed by GitHub Security Lab. Reported 2025-08-04; maintainers confirmed a fix on 2025-08-17. This attribution does not establish which contribution found the flaw first.
classification_note: The advisory documents the finding and its disclosure/remediation state. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Maintainer reported the fix in PR 22458 on 2025-08-17. No CVE was established in the advisory.
